entities.name: Hagi Village
entities.description: A human village on the Towabara Plains of Kamigawa, struck by plague during the Kami War.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Lord who ordered Hagi Village quarantined.

entities.name: Wise-Muzzle
entities.description: A kitsune healer who treated the sick and gained a sixth tail.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War before whose end the plague struck.

events.summary: A plague strikes Hagi Village, dotting almost every inhabitant with black pock-marks.
Lord Takeshi Konda orders the village quarantined, allowing no more than five healers inside.
events.quote: Lord Takeshi Konda ordered the village quarantined

events.summary: Wise-Muzzle tends the sick for days; they lose a quarter of the village but save three times more, and he wakes with a sixth tail.
events.quote: They lost a quarter of the village but saved three times more.
